Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.  Freudenberg Business Services SRL
You support our team as
 AI Solutions Engineer 
 Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and implement AI solutions, including Generative AI, LLM-based applications, RAG solutions, and agentic workflows.
Build and maintain AI services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask.
Develop and support SQL-based integrations, ETL pipelines, and enterprise data connections for AI applications.
Deploy, monitor, and optimize AI solutions on Microsoft Azure, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
Implement MLOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, testing, monitoring, and deployment automation.
Ensure compliance with AI governance, security, data protection, and operational standards.
Collaborate with business and technical teams to translate requirements into impactful AI solutions.
Promote AI adoption through knowledge sharing, training, and best practice development.
 Qualifications 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, AI engineering, or machine learning roles.
Strong Python development skills and experience building APIs with FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and deploying cloud-based applications and AI solutions in production environments.
Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, AI APIs, RAG architectures, SQL, ETL pipelines, enterprise data integration, and AI solution development best practices.
Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, MLOps, cloud security, and knowledge of technologies such as vector databases, Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Terraform, Azure AI Services, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, and GitHub Copilot.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international teams; relevant cloud or AI certifications are a plus.
